progress.definition: Same assigned service identity and path removes exactly its first remaining stop while preserving the expected tail. Bounds are source snapshot times, not physical departure times. Headway ranges compare successive disjoint reported transitions in one station/direction/day/continuous segment; local unknown transitions prevent pairing.
progress.limitations: Feed-derived reported progression only. Skipped/rerouted or unseen service and internal feed lag can differ from physical departures. Source sampling coverage does not prove complete operator reporting. Gaps, identity/path changes, ambiguous joins, terminal boundaries and whole-trip disappearance are excluded or unknown. No actual lateness, all-day train total or global punctuality ranking.

legacyEpoch.limitations: Frozen v1 rule counts, not verified physical delays. Entity measurement freshness was unverified; false positives and false negatives are possible.

scope: Assigned E trip/run records in the official ACE feed only; missing/rerouted/unassigned records and pre-collection time are not a complete physical-train denominator.

model.definition: An assigned trip still lists the same first remaining stop at least five minutes after its first usable future departure/arrival prediction (within one hour) recorded while that stop was first. Departure is preferred by taking the later arrival/departure time. Only fresh advancing feed and explicit trip-update measurement timestamps classify flags; missing optional entity timestamps mean insufficient evidence under this rule, not a defective or proven stale feed. Operations identifier changes reset the baseline. This is a prediction-overrun estimate, not published-timetable lateness or an independently confirmed physical arrival.
model.identity: Source start_date + origin time encoded in the official trip identifier + route E + direction. Optional path aliases do not create new runs; conflicting simultaneous operations identifiers/stops are excluded. Physical trainsets are not counted.
model.limitations: Already-overdue first observations, stale/failing samples, gaps, unassigned/ambiguous records and earlier today are excluded or unknown. Zero flags does not establish zero actual delays. Episodes split at gaps have unknown boundaries; Flags are recorded on the New York calendar day they are observed. False positives and false negatives for physical delays are possible; these counts are neither a lower bound nor complete physical delay totals.
